meta_description: VIEREK is the technology company behind GAMEWISE. We build software, mobile apps, video games and digital solutions with artificial intelligence from Salta, Argentina.
og_title: VIEREK · AI software, apps and games
og_description: The technology company behind GAMEWISE. From Salta, Argentina.
hero_title: AI software, apps and games, built in Salta.
hero_lead: VIEREK is the technology company behind GAMEWISE. From northern Argentina, we build our own products and digital solutions powered by artificial intelligence.
what_lead: We build our own products and work with companies that want to solve a specific problem with technology. We tell you what we'll solve, by when, and how you'll measure the result.
area1_d: Custom web platforms and systems, built to grow and to be maintained.
area2_d: iOS and Android apps, from design to store release.
area3_d: Games and tools for players, with AI applied to how people play.
area4_d: Data, automation and artificial intelligence for real processes.
gw_text: It remembers how each person plays, analyzes their matches against the goal they choose and measures their progress with evidence from their own rounds. Other tools show what happened; GAMEWISE handles what comes next.
next_d: a new AI gaming project, in development at VIEREK. We'll present it when it opens to investment.
inv_lead: We're opening our first round to validate GAMEWISE with real players and launch it at the FiReMAJOR Buenos Aires 2027.
why1_d: The MVP is in production and open to use. It won the KRANKETHON Salta Gaming + IDEA in November 2026.
why2_d: No platform combines player memory, a goal the player chooses and measurable progress against that goal.
why3_d: The first CS2 Major in Argentina is played in Buenos Aires between May and June 2027.
road1_d: MVP in production and KRANKETHON winners.
road2_d: Real player data across the whole improvement loop.
road3_d: Accounts, history and persistent player memory.
road4_d: Validation with real players from the community.
road5_d: Launch at the FiReMAJOR Buenos Aires.
step1_d: Tell us what you're looking for and we'll answer your questions.
step2_d: The live app and the full pitch.
step3_d: Budget, projections, shareholders' agreement and technical documentation.
meet_text: Write to us with the days and times that work for you and we'll send a Google Meet invite.
meet_small: Argentina time (UTC−3). Round details are shared in the meeting.
team_lead: Four co-founders with experience in software, product, communication and the competitive CS scene.
team1: Senior Full Stack Developer with 8+ years of experience. Founder of SecureHub. 3,000+ hours in CS.
team2: Tech Lead and Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience. Co-founder of Pacha Team.
team3: Functional analysis and process mapping. Studying Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps.
team4: Degree in Communication Sciences (UNSa). Sales, social media and digital content.
contact_lead: For projects, partnerships or investment, write to us and we'll get back to you.
footer_gw: GAMEWISE is a product of VIEREK S.A.S.
